claim.claim-text: 1. A decoding apparatus for an image decoding, the decoding apparatus comprising:

a memory; and at least one processor connected to the memory, the at least one processor configured to: derive a history-based motion vector prediction, HMVP, candidate list for a current block, wherein the HMVP candidate list comprises an HMVP candidate including motion information of a previous block which is decoded prior to the current block; derive motion information candidate list based on the HMVP candidate comprised in the HMVP candidate list, wherein for deriving the motion information candidate list, the HMVP candidate is added in the motion information candidate list; derive motion information of the current block based on the motion information candidate list; generate prediction samples for the current block based on the motion information; and generate reconstructed samples based on the prediction samples, wherein a current picture includes more than one tile, wherein the current block is for one of coding units, CUs, split from a coding tree unit, CTU, wherein the HMVP candidate list is updated by adding motion information of a previous block which is decoded prior to the current block as a new HMVP candidate, wherein for the current picture consisting of 2 tile rows and 2 tile columns, the number of HMVP candidates comprised in the HMVP candidate list is set to zero at a first CTU in a processing order in each CTU row of each tile, wherein the decoding apparatus further configured to:

determine whether the CTU is a first CTU in a processing order in a CTU row of a current tile of the current picture consisting of the 2 tile rows and the 2 tile columns, wherein the HMVP candidate list for the current block is derived based on the result of the determination, and wherein based on the result of the determination that the CTU is the first CTU in the processing order in the CTU row of the current tile of the current picture consisting of the 2 tile rows and the 2 tile columns, the number of the HMVP candidates comprised in the HMVP candidate list is set to zero for the CTU.
2. An encoding apparatus for an image encoding, the encoding apparatus comprising:
a memory; and at least one processor connected to the memory, the at least one processor configured to:

determine whether the CTU is a first CTU in a processing order in a CTU row of a current tile of the current picture consisting of the 2 tile rows and the 2 tile columns, wherein the HMVP candidate list for the current block is derived based on the result of the determination, and wherein based on the result of the determination that the CTU is the first CTU in the processing order in the CTU row of the current tile of the current picture consisting of the 2 tile rows and the 2 tile columns, the number of the HMVP candidates comprised in the HMVP candidate list is set to zero for the CTU.
3. An apparatus for transmitting data for an image, the apparatus comprising:

at least one processor configured to obtain a bitstream generated based on a method, wherein the method comprising: deriving a history-based motion vector prediction, HMVP, candidate list for a current block, wherein the HMVP candidate list comprises an HMVP candidate including motion information of a previous block which is encoded prior to the current block, deriving a motion information candidate list based on an HMVP candidate comprised in the HMVP candidate list, wherein for deriving the motion information candidate list, the HMVP candidate is added in the motion information candidate list, deriving motion information of the current block based on the motion information candidate list, generating prediction samples for the current block based on the motion information, deriving residual samples based on the prediction samples, and encoding image information comprising information on the residual samples; and a transmitter configured to transmit the data comprising the bitstream, wherein more than one tile is present in a current picture, wherein the current block is for one of coding units, CUs, split from a coding tree unit, CTU, wherein the HMVP candidate list is updated by adding motion information of a previous block which is encoded prior to the current block as a new HMVP candidate, wherein for the current picture consisting of 2 tile rows and 2 tile columns, the number of HMVP candidates comprised in the HMVP candidate list is set to zero at a first CTU in a processing order in each CTU row of each tile, wherein the method further comprising:

determining whether the CTU is a first CTU in a processing order in a CTU row of a current tile of the current picture consisting of the 2 tile rows and the 2 tile columns, wherein the HMVP candidate list for the current block is derived based on the result of the determination, and wherein based on the result of the determination that the CTU is the first CTU in the processing order in the CTU row of the current tile of the current picture consisting of the 2 tile rows and the 2 tile columns, the number of the HMVP candidates comprised in the HMVP candidate list is set to zero for the CTU.
